lines.text: Many learners say: He was absent in class yesterday.
Better: He was absent from class yesterday.
Use absent from a place or an event.
From! He was absent from class yesterday.

data.wrong: He was absent in class yesterday.
data.right: He was absent from class yesterday.
data.why: Use absent from a place or an event.
